title: Object-oriented C# — one screen
rememberThis: C# has one base class. Extra capabilities are interfaces or composition — the pattern you already use across microservices.
virtual/override is the real dispatch table. new hides; it does not override. sealed stops further override.
record (class) uses value equality and with-expressions. Redis DTOs and auth tokens belong here. Dictionary keys need GetHashCode that matches Equals — next topic.
bullets: Prefer injecting collaborators over deep domain hierarchies in workers and API hosts.
Default interface methods (C# 8) ship evolution without breaking implementers; explicit implementation hides members from the class surface.
record struct is a value type with value equality; record class is a reference type with value equality.
TypeScript private is compile-time. CLR private is metadata the runtime enforces.
